'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***More than 190 [[Palestinians]] are killed and hundreds more are wounded by [[Israeli Air Force|Israeli]] [[airstrike]]s on the [[Gaza Strip]], including [[Khan Younis]] in the south. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/israeli-bombs-hundreds-of-targets-in-gaza-as-truce-efforts-continue (Al Jazeera)]
***The [[United Nations]] say the fighting will worsen the extreme [[humanitarian]] emergency in Gaza. UN [[humanitarian aid|aid]] chief [[Martin Griffiths]] said that the people of Gaza had nowhere safe to go and very little to survive on. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/israeli-bombs-hundreds-of-targets-in-gaza-as-truce-efforts-continue (Al Jazeera)]
**The [[United States]] provides [[BLU-109]] [[bunker buster]] bombs and other [[munitions]] to [[Israel]]. Similar bombs made by the US were used by Israel in the [[Jabalia refugee camp airstrikes]], including a strike that levelled an apartment block, killing more than 100 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/us-gives-bunker-buster-bombs-to-israel-for-war-on-gaza-report (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Islamic terrorism in Europe]], [[Terrorism in France]]
**[[2023 Paris attack]]
***One person is killed and two others are injured in a knife and hammer attack near the [[Eiffel Tower]] in [[Paris]], [[France]]. The suspect is arrested by [[Paris Police Prefecture|police]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/one-dead-one-injured-after-assailant-attacks-passersby-paris-minister-2023-12-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Moro conflict]]
**Bomb maker Mundi Sawadjaan, a leader of [[Abu Sayyaf]] and suspect in the [[2020 Jolo bombings|2020 suicide bombings in Sulu]], is killed by [[Philippine Army|security forces]] during a [[military operation]] in [[Basilan]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2023/12/03/abu-sayyaf-bomb-maker-killed-by-philippine-security-forces (''The Star'')]
*Spillover of the [[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[Chilas bus shooting]]
***Eight people are killed and 26 others injured in a [[mass shooting]] against a bus on the [[Karakoram Highway]] near the town of [[Chilas]], [[Gilgit-Baltistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/12/2/gunmen-kill-eight-bus-passengers-in-northern-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[December 2023 Mindanao earthquake]]
**A person is killed when a 7.5 magnitude [[list of earthquakes in the Philippines|earthquake]] strikes off the coast of [[Mindanao]], [[Philippines]]. [[Tsunami warning]]s are issued for the [[Philippines]] and [[Japan]], but are later lifted. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-lifts-tsunami-alert-after-magnitude-74-earthquake-2023-12-03/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Al-Qadir Trust case]]
**The [[Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf|Pakistan Movement for Justice]] party appoints [[Gohar Ali Khan]] as its new chairman, replacing party founder and former [[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]], who remains [[First arrest of Imran Khan|detained]] on various [[criminal charge|charges]]. [https://www.thedailystar.net/news/asia/south-asia/news/pakistan-ex-pm-imran-khan-replaced-party-head-3483991 (AFP via ''The Daily Star'')]
*[[Human rights in Ukraine]]
**[[Ukraine]]'s [[Security Service of Ukraine|security service]] stops former [[President of Ukraine|president]] [[Petro Poroshenko]] from leaving the country. Poroshenko's [[political party]], [[European Solidarity]], said he had scheduled meetings in [[Poland]] and the United States. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20231202-ukraine-blocks-ex-president-from-leaving-country-amid-alleged-plan-to-meet-pro-putin-hungary-s-orban (Reuters via France 24)]
